fig1_decoherence_T1_T2.svg: Spontaneous-emission decoherence from evolve_lindblad on the $|+\rangle$ state ($\hbar=1$). The excited population $\rho_{ee}$ (blue) decays at $\gamma$ ($T_1$) while the coherence $|\rho_{eg}|$ (orange) decays at $\gamma/2$, so $T_2=2T_1$; adding pure dephasing $\gamma_\phi$ (purple) damps only the coherence, $1/T_2=\gamma/2+\gamma_\phi$. Dashed: the closed forms the simulation reproduces.
fig2_optical_bloch_saturation.svg: Driven-damped steady state $\rho_{ee}^{ss}=(\Omega^2/4)/(\Delta^2+\gamma^2/4+\Omega^2/2)$ vs Rabi frequency for detunings $\Delta=0,1,2.5\,\gamma$. Curves are steady_state_excited_population; dots are $\rho_{ee}$ at long time from evolve_lindblad driven out of $|g\rangle$. The population rises toward $\frac{1}{2}$ but never crosses it — a classical field can equalize but cannot invert a two-level atom.
